name: Ring Triceps Push-Up (Incline Rings)
description: A push-up on gymnastic rings set to an elevated angle, creating an incline position that reduces body weight load. This is used as a progression step toward full ring push-ups. The unstable rings demand significant stabilizer recruitment even at this reduced intensity.

execution.starting_position: Set up for Ring Triceps Push-Up (Incline Rings) in the appropriate position.
execution.setup_instructions: Prepare equipment and body position for Ring Triceps Push-Up (Incline Rings).
steps: Step 1: Set rings at chest height for incline. Grip rings and lean body at an angle.
Step 2: Maintain body rigidity and lower chest toward rings by bending elbows.
Step 3: Keep elbows tucked, rings allowed to rotate naturally.
Step 4: Press back to full arm extension, rotating rings outward.
execution.breathing_instructions: Exhale during the exertion phase, inhale during the return.
safety_considerations: Keep joints aligned throughout the movement.
Use controlled weight appropriate for skill level.
execution.range_of_motion_guidance: Move through full range of motion without compromising joint integrity.
coaching_cues: Turn rings out at the top
